user.title: Cloud Quota Guard
user.description: Discover cloud integrations and monitor verified quota sources. Automatically reads supported existing GitHub and Google credentials locally. Warns at 90% and disables mapped integrations at 95%. Missing sources are not protected. The bundled dashboard currently uses Hebrew.

abort.already_configured: Cloud Quota Guard is already configured.

configure.name: Configure quota
configure.description: Register a verified measurement source and target integrations.

id.name: Metric ID
id.description: Stable lowercase identifier (letters, digits and underscores).

entry_ids.name: Target integration IDs
entry_ids.description: Config entry IDs to disable at the cutoff; cannot target Quota Guard itself.

kind.name: Quota type
kind.description: Distinguish a rate limit, free allowance, or monetary budget.

source.name: Verified source
source.description: Provider documentation URL or a clear description of the usage source.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: For example requests, characters, or USD.

usage_entity.name: Usage sensor
usage_entity.description: Current-period usage sensor with period and source timestamp attributes.

limit_entity.name: Limit sensor
limit_entity.description: Optional sensor exposing the effective allowance.

limit.name: Fixed allowance
limit.description: A verified allowance if no limit sensor is available.

period_attribute.name: Period attribute
period_attribute.description: Usage sensor attribute containing the provider period ID.

timestamp_attribute.name: Timestamp attribute
timestamp_attribute.description: Usage sensor attribute with the timezone-aware source timestamp.

max_age.name: Maximum age
max_age.description: Seconds until a measurement is considered stale (30–86400).

enforce.name: Disable at 95%
enforce.description: Disable explicitly mapped integrations at 95%; never automatically re-enable them.

report.name: Report measurement
report.description: Submit a verified quota measurement. Administrator access is required.

id.name: Metric ID
id.description: ID of a metric previously registered with configure.

used.name: Used
used.description: Verified consumption in the current provider period.

limit.name: Allowance
limit.description: Verified effective allowance for this period.

period.name: Period
period.description: Provider period identifier; changes reset threshold notification latches.

timestamp.name: Source timestamp
timestamp.description: Timezone-aware ISO 8601 timestamp of the provider measurement.
